channelMonitors.title: YouTube channels
channelMonitors.intro: Watch a channel and every new upload becomes a task on its own, with that channel's defaults below. Channels are checked about every 15 minutes (that is how often YouTube refreshes its feeds), and tasks queue one at a time like manual ones.
channelMonitors.masterToggleHint: When on, the app checks your channels for new uploads.
channelMonitors.clipNewest: Also clip the newest video now
channelMonitors.baselineNote: Videos already on the channel are only marked as seen — they are never clipped. Only new uploads after you add the channel become tasks, unless you tick the box above to clip the newest one now.

defaults.momentsWarning: Find Moments tasks pause and wait for your pick; if you don't pick within 15 minutes they continue with the top picks automatically.
defaults.dailyCapHint: 1–20, or leave blank for no cap. Extra uploads are listed as skipped, not queued for tomorrow.
defaults.campaignPlaceholder: Stamp this campaign on new tasks
defaults.brandKitPlaceholder: Stamp this brand kit on new tasks

channelMonitors.listEmpty: No channels yet. Add one above and new uploads will clip themselves.
